_schema.listen: host:port — where the proxy listens for incoming requests
_schema.upstream: host:port — where the llama-server (router) is running
_schema.save_path: string — folder where KV cache files are saved; leave empty to auto-detect
_schema.min_save_tokens: int >= 0 — don't bother saving conversations shorter than this
_schema.n_max_files: int >= 0 — max number of cache files to keep on disk (0 = no limit)
_schema.max_gb: float >= 0 — max total disk space for cache files in GB (0 = no limit)
_schema.thrash_window: int >= 2 — how many recent requests to watch for rapid switching
_schema.thrash_max_switches: int >= 0 — how many switches in the window before pausing saves
_schema.tail_match_min: int >= 1 — how many matching tail tokens to detect a rewritten conversation
_schema.cache_reuse: int >= 0 — min chunk size to slide KV on rewrite (0 = off)
_schema.cache_reuse_mode: targeted | always — targeted = only on detected rewrites; always = every request
_schema.health_poll_ms: int > 0 — how often to check if the server is still alive (ms)
_schema.control_timeout_ms: int > 0 — max time to wait for save/restore calls before giving up (ms)
_schema.api_key: string — the server's API key, sent along with control calls
